items.stem: A user built a beautiful desktop homepage in a visual builder, but on phones the text overlaps images. What should they do first?

options.text: Switch to the builder's mobile view and adjust spacing, sizes and element order for small screens
options.rationale: Correct: hosted builders provide a mobile editor whose layout must be reviewed and adjusted separately.

options.text: Tell visitors to use a computer
options.rationale: You cannot dictate visitors' devices; the mobile layout must work.
Removing content is unnecessary; the layout simply needs mobile adjustment.

options.text: Rebuild the entire site in code
options.rationale: Hand-coding is not required; the builder's mobile tools solve this.

items.explanation: Correct: hosted builders provide a mobile editor whose layout must be reviewed and adjusted separately.

items.stem: Which TWO tasks are genuinely part of preparing a site for search engines and assistive technology? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Writing descriptive page titles and meta descriptions
options.rationale: Correct: page titles and descriptions are core on-page SEO.

options.text: Adding meaningful alt text to images
options.rationale: Correct: alt text supports screen-reader users and image context.

options.text: Choosing a trendy animation for the logo
options.rationale: Animation is decorative and does not serve SEO or accessibility.

options.text: Using the largest available font everywhere
options.rationale: Oversized type is not an accessibility or SEO measure.

items.explanation: Correct: page titles and descriptions are core on-page SEO.

items.stem: Before connecting a custom domain purchased elsewhere, a user publishes and sees only a builder subdomain. Why?

options.text: The custom domain must be connected and verified in the builder's settings before it serves the site
options.rationale: Correct: a purchased domain only points to the site once connected and verified.

options.text: Custom domains are not supported by hosted builders
options.rationale: Hosted builders do support custom domains once configured.

options.text: The site must be rebuilt for the domain to appear
options.rationale: No rebuild is needed; only domain connection.

options.text: Subdomains are permanent and cannot be changed
options.rationale: The subdomain is temporary until the custom domain is connected.

items.explanation: Correct: a purchased domain only points to the site once connected and verified.
